title: Interpretable and Steerable Molecular Graph Generation using Concept Bottlenecks
abstract: arXiv:2610.34227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep graph generators (DGGs) largely lack interpretability, which is a significant limitation for one of their most crucial applications, drug discovery, where interpretable and transparent generation could provide greater control over the desirability of generated molecules, thereby reducing trial-and-error in candidate selection. Common approaches to interpretability, such as disentanglement, cannot guarantee that the learned representations are human-interpretable. To address this, we propose incorporating concept bottlenecks into DGGs, allowing users to interpret, debug, and steer the generation process. We show that this consistently improves distributional fidelity (lower FCD), with only modest, non-systematic effects on validity and uniqueness. We further explore Concept Controller, an optimization-based steering approach that has proven to be effective for steerable image generation. We evaluate our approach on a one-shot molecul

translated_title: 使用概念瓶颈实现可解释与可控的分子图生成
translated_abstract: 深度图生成器在很大程度上缺乏可解释性，这对其最重要的应用之一——药物发现——构成了重大限制。在药物发现中，可解释和透明的生成过程能够对生成分子的理想程度提供更强的控制，从而减少候选分子筛选中的试错成本。常见的可解释性方法（如解耦表示学习）无法保证学习到的表示对人类是可解释的。为解决这一问题，我们提出将概念瓶颈融入深度图生成器中，使用户能够对生成过程进行解释、调试和引导。我们证明了这种方法能够持续提升分布保真度（更低的FCD），同时对有效性和唯一性仅有适度的、非系统性的影响。我们进一步提出了Concept Controller，这是一种基于优化的引导方法，已被证明对可控图像生成有效。我们在单次分子生成任务上评估了我们的方法。
tldr: 该论文提出将概念瓶颈融入深度图生成器，使分子生成过程具备人类可解释性并支持用户引导，在提升分布保真度的同时为药物发现提供了更透明的分子生成方案。
en_tdlr: This paper incorporates concept bottlenecks into deep graph generators, enabling interpretable, debuggable, and steerable molecular generation with improved distributional fidelity, offering a more transparent approach for drug discovery.
